description: Curated license map for native components of the NaviVeylin build.
Authoritative for every native component in the SBOM: the build resolves each
component's license from this file and fails when a component has no entry.
`declared` is the license expression as stated by the component's own metadata;
where it offers a choice, the election relied upon lives in license-policy.json
(one place for elections, one place for component facts).
`scope` records whether the component's code is distributed: "shipped" means the
code is linked into a shared object packaged in the APK (evidence: the packaged
artifact plus the CMake link list), "buildTimeOnly" means it is installed on the
build machine but contributes no shipped binary. License *text* is required only
for shipped components, because only those texts are distributed by the app.
`caveat` flags an entry whose claim is not fully evidenced and must be surfaced
(the gate reports caveats rather than silently accepting them).
probeSymbolsNote: How each shipped component's code is recognised inside a packaged shared
object. `exact` matches a defined dynamic symbol; `prefix` matches a symbol
prefix (used where the component's symbols are C++ mangled). Components
without probes are recognised by their packaged object name (libosmscout,
libomp) or, as a fallback, by their static archives appearing in the native
link configuration (expat exports no symbol the probe can match).

bzip2.evidence: vcpkg/ports/bzip2/vcpkg.json; linked into libosmscout_map_cairo*.so (libbz2.a in app/src/main/cpp/CMakeLists.txt)

cairo.evidence: vcpkg/ports/cairo/vcpkg.json; cairo_create defined in packaged libosmscout_map_cairo*.so

fontconfig.evidence: vcpkg/ports/fontconfig/vcpkg.json; FcInit defined in packaged libosmscout_map_cairo*.so

freetype.evidence: vcpkg/ports/freetype/vcpkg.json; FT_Init_FreeType defined in packaged libosmscout_map_cairo*.so

libosmscout.evidence: libosmscout submodule README.md §License ("The libraries itself are under LGPL"); packaged as separate libosmscout*.so files
libosmscout.caveat: The submodule LICENSE file contains the GNU GPL v2 text and no Lesser section, while README.md states LGPL; no source file carries a version clause. The LGPL-2.1-or-later value follows the upstream statement and must be confirmed by the owner of the application license decision.

libpng.evidence: vcpkg/ports/libpng/vcpkg.json; png_read_image defined in packaged libosmscout_map_cairo*.so

libomp.evidence: Packaged as lib/<abi>/libomp.so and NEEDED by libosmscout*.so; runtime ships with the Android NDK LLVM toolchain (app/build.gradle.kts ndkVersion)

marisa-trie.evidence: vcpkg-overlays port; marisa symbols defined in packaged libosmscoutd.so (libmarisa.a via app/src/main/cpp/CMakeLists.txt)

zlib.evidence: vcpkg/ports/zlib/vcpkg.json; zlibVersion defined in packaged libosmscout_map_cairo*.so

abseil.evidence: vcpkg/ports/abseil/vcpkg.json; no shipped symbol or archive attribution

dirent.evidence: vcpkg/ports/dirent/vcpkg.json; installs no library for Android (share/dirent holds only vcpkg_abi_info.txt and vcpkg.spdx.json)
dirent.caveat: Port ships no copyright file; the identifier comes from the port's own vcpkg.json declaration.

fribidi.evidence: vcpkg/ports/fribidi/vcpkg.json; no pango/fribidi code linked (pango not part of the app's link set)

gettext.evidence: vcpkg/ports/gettext/vcpkg.json; build-time message tooling, no shipped code

gettext-libintl.evidence: vcpkg/ports/gettext-libintl/vcpkg.json; not part of the shipped link set

glib.evidence: vcpkg/ports/glib/vcpkg.json; no glib symbols in any packaged shared object

harfbuzz.evidence: vcpkg/ports/harfbuzz/vcpkg.json; no harfbuzz symbols in any packaged shared object

libffi.evidence: vcpkg/ports/libffi/vcpkg.json; glib dependency, no shipped code

libiconv.evidence: installs no library for Android; the iconv symbols in the packaged cairo object come from the app's own app/src/main/cpp/iconv_stub.c
libiconv.caveat: Port declares no license and ships no copyright file; the identifier follows upstream GNU libiconv. No libiconv code is distributed.

liblzma.evidence: vcpkg installed copyright states liblzma is under the BSD Zero Clause License; not part of the shipped link set
liblzma.caveat: Port declares no license field; the identifier comes from the installed copyright text.

libuuid.evidence: vcpkg/ports/libuuid/vcpkg.json; glib dependency, no shipped code

libxml2.evidence: vcpkg/ports/libxml2/vcpkg.json; no libxml2 evidence in the packaged shared objects

pango.evidence: vcpkg/ports/pango/vcpkg.json; zero pango traces in the packaged shared objects (the cairo backend builds without PANGOCAIRO)

pcre2.evidence: vcpkg/ports/pcre2/vcpkg.json; glib dependency, no shipped code

protobuf.evidence: vcpkg/ports/protobuf/vcpkg.json; no protobuf evidence in the packaged shared objects

pthread.evidence: installs no library for Android (share/pthread holds only vcpkg_abi_info.txt and vcpkg.spdx.json)
pthread.caveat: Port declares no license and ships no copyright file; winpthreads from mingw-w64 is MIT. No code is distributed.

pthreads.evidence: vcpkg/ports/pthreads/vcpkg.json; installs no library for Android
pthreads.caveat: Port ships no copyright file; the identifier comes from the port's own vcpkg.json declaration. No code is distributed.

utf8-range.evidence: vcpkg/ports/utf8-range/vcpkg.json; protobuf dependency, no shipped code
